errors.text_span: 图表主要通过柱子内部的水平线条阴影纹理、顶部的精确数值标注，以及横轴下方与类别对齐的数据表格对各项数据进行了视觉维度的强调与展示。
errors.evidence: The description misinterprets common chart features (fill patterns, data labels, an accompanying data table) as forms of "visual emphasis". These features are applied universally to all data elements and serve to present information, not to emphasize or highlight any specific bar or group over others. The correct statement would be that there is no visual emphasis on any particular element.
